name: Imitation City
original_name: イミテーションシティ
source:
In 2017, a rebellion of clones made with the use of biotechnology begins and you get caught in the middle of it.

[From [url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/04/vn-of-year-1987.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
2017年，利用生物技术制造的克隆人发动叛乱，而你恰好被卷入冲突中心。

[引自[url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/04/vn-of-year-1987.html]vndbreview[/url]]
